sample_row_decisions.evidence_summary: The sampled DBAASP assay row is source-backed. The packet database row at linked_assay_records.jsonl line 19 records DBAASPS_24526 / Oct-Tridecaptin A2 [6-Aib], MIC 3.13 ug/ml, against Escherichia coli NCTC 12241. Primary XML Table 1 row for compound 21 lists Ec MIC 3.13 with the Table 1 footnote defining Ec as E. coli NCTC 12241 and MIC units as ug/mL; the final activity row src-table1-compound-21-mic-ec preserves endpoint, value, unit, species, strain, assay conditions, duplicate replicate note, and xml:table=1:row=13 locator. The final database audit row points to the same activity record and database traceability, so the source_verified status is acceptable for this sampled row. Cautions remain because the paper-level review has an unrelated hemolysis-source ambiguity, the packet/release stored TSV row number is stale while the audit_record_id resolves the correct release line, and the accepted mechanism artifact has non-standard evidence classes requiring targeted rework.
